# Protection from Energy (`spells:protection-from-energy`)
**Level 3 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** up to 1 hour | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

For the duration, the willing creature you touch has Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.
